title: [finding] ActionRunner.isValidUrl refuses mailto:, so a url action or element:button whose target is mailto: parses and publishes, then answers an error toast at click
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2775 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2784). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

The spec accepts a `mailto:` target on a `type: 'url'` action and on a page `element:button`. objectui's runner refuses it at click.

## Evidence (objectui at cloud's pin `d758f2f2`)

- `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` `navigateTo` / `isValidUrl` accepts only `http://`, `https://`, `/` and `./`. Anything else answers "Invalid URL scheme. Only http://, https://, and relative URLs are allowed."
- In contrast, `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog`'s anchor CTA (`resolveCtaHref`) does accept `mailto:`.
- **Producer:** cloud `packages/service-cloud/src/routes/environment-lifecycle.ts:260`, where `CONTACT_SALES_URL` defaults to `mailto:sales@objectos.ai`.
  - The maintainer-accepted ruling for objectstack-ai/cloud#2775 asks the coming-soon upgrade buttons to read 「联系我们开通」 with a mail or form path.
  - Because of this refusal, cloud shipped the contact as confirm and page text instead of a working mail button (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2784).

## Why it matters

The spec accepts the target, so it publishes cleanly, and the only signal is a toast at click: an AI-authored mail button is a dead button nobody sees in review. Either the runner allows `mailto:` (and `tel:`?) for url targets, or the spec refuses them at publish. The seam should not be lenient on one side and strict on the other.

Seam: `spec:ActionSchema.target` (type `url`) → `renderer:objectui ActionRunner`.

Dedupe: searched open objectui issues for `isValidUrl` and `mailto`: none.
